facts.fact: The World Bank's restructuring paper states that 444 of the safety net programme's 492 woredas use its management information system for programme tracking, and that the data of 5.1 million of 7.9 million beneficiaries have been synchronised in the federal system, full operation being expected by end December 2025; it does not say how the woredas are connected.
facts.system: Productive Safety Net Program management information system (PSNP MIS)

facts.fact: 444 woredas use the safety net programme's management information system for programme tracking, of the 492 woredas in the programme, on the World Bank's restructuring paper of October 2025; the 492 is the programme's count, not the country's count of woredas.
facts.system: Productive Safety Net Program management information system (PSNP MIS)

facts.fact: The World Bank states that the safety net programme, which hosts the management information system, is managed by the Government of Ethiopia through its structures from federal to woreda level, with the Ministry of Agriculture as responsible agency.
facts.system: Productive Safety Net Program management information system (PSNP MIS)

facts.fact: The management information system is developed under Component 3 (systems, capacity development and programme management support) of a World Bank IDA-financed project supporting the safety net programme, which 14 development partners finance; no domestic budget line for the system is stated.
facts.system: Productive Safety Net Program management information system (PSNP MIS)
